claims.text: The latest stable release of Pulumi is v3.263.0 released 2026-09-16 (L134 table alternatively lists v3.261.0 released 2026-09-02) — the post's Pulumi latest-version figures are inconsistent between the at-a-glance table and the license/cadence table and Pulumi section.
The at-a-glance table lists Pulumi's latest stable release as v3.261.0 (2026-09-02), as of 2026-09-21.
The at-a-glance table lists Terraform's latest stable release as v1.16.1 (2026-09-02), as of 2026-09-21.
The at-a-glance table lists AWS CDK's latest stable release as v2.268.0 (2026-09-02), as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable release of Terraform is v1.16.3, released 2026-09-16.
The latest stable release of AWS CDK is v2.270.0, released 2026-09-17.
The latest stable release of Azure Bicep is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08.
The at-a-glance table lists Azure Bicep's latest stable release as v0.46.1 (2026-07-30), as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
The at-a-glance table lists Crossplane's latest stable release as v2.4.0 (2026-08-20), as of 2026-09-21.
The latest stable release of Crossplane is v2.4.1, released 2026-09-15.
The latest stable release of OpenTofu is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19, as of 2026-09-21.
The version and release-date figures in the post were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
GitHub star counts as of 2026-09-21: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.
Among dedicated IaC tools, Terraform is the most-starred on GitHub, followed by OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, and Crossplane; Kubernetes leads the broader infrastructure ecosystem by stars.

Terraform's larger community reflects a decade of first-mover adoption, while Pulumi, OpenTofu, and Crossplane have grown fastest among teams prioritizing general-purpose languages, open governance, or Kubernetes-native infrastructure management, respectively.
The pricing table reflects published pricing as of September 2026.
Env zero is formerly known as env0.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
Env zero prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month, including 40 credits and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month, including 400 credits and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise pricing is custom and contract-based.
HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then moves to per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
Terraform Enterprise (self-hosted) is available at custom pricing for larger organizations.
The pricing figures were checked on 2026-09-21.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager will be fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Terraform's 2023 move to the Business Source License is the reason OpenTofu exists; OpenTofu forked from Terraform's last MPL-2.0 release and now operates under Linux Foundation governance.
HashiCorp is an IBM company.
